headline: Ferrari, McLaren and Red Bull bring upgrades to Austin
body: Ferrari's package has four parts: a revised floor body, floor board, sidepod inlet and diffuser. McLaren has new front and rear corners and a modified diffuser, and Red Bull a new front wing and front corner. Mercedes brings nothing new but runs the latest-specification W17 on both cars.

headline: Verstappen is on the limit for six of seven power unit elements
body: Verstappen is on his last allowed engine, turbocharger, MGU-K, energy store, control electronics and exhaust, with six races left. He says a grid penalty will "potentially" come at some point but has no date, and he is not due to take new components in Austin.
